about: The Workbench icons of the Overgod drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/overgod.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a small ship firing into a ring of glowing shapes) is The AmiCradle Team's own, GPL-2 or later like the game; art/overgod.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Overgod-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Overgod.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Overgod and COPYING.txt.
